scientific_question: Does per-neuron agreement across independent real-record teaching gradients improve transferable next-byte learning and revised feedback while reducing late-pass overfitting, beyond a lower effective hidden step size?

operative_model.local_source: V167/V179 fixed random output-error feedback through H512/T2048 ReLU; readout local CE
operative_model.sensor: literal FE-PERM fixed sparse KC, 5177 KCs + empty5177 and pad5178
operative_model.only_scientific_change: multiplicative effective post-AdamW H/T neuron-wise applied-step factor based on same-minibatch source-local gradient vector cosine across 2 record-distinct groups

gate.name: CGLP
gate.unreliable_batch: if group1 or group2 fewer than 2 distinct records, coherence=0 for all hidden neurons; report fraction
gate.split_assignment: sort distinct raw record IDs within batch by sha256('V180|micro|'+recordID), alternate into halves, never split a record
gate.g1g2: ordinary V167 H/T local teaching gradients (weights plus bias) normalized by actual group target count, using same single forward/dropout batch
gate.full_gradient_reconstruction: (n1*g1+n2*g2)/(n1+n2) equals literal V179 H/T gradient; finite-difference and source parity
gate.moment_rule: all Adam moments/step clocks updated from original full unscaled gradient, all phases

arms.role: literal original V179 local learner control
smaller effective hidden step/weight decay control

arms.gain: per-H and per-T layer gain sqrt(sum(gamma_neuron^2 * ||unscaled_adam_step||^2)/sum(||unscaled_adam_step||^2))
arms.role: per-batch approximately write-energy matched nonselective control

arms.gain: 0.25+0.75*positive cosine of two record-disjoint per-neuron local gradient vectors

corpus.provider: NLTK Gutenberg fileids (no network substitute once source-locked)
corpus.preprocessing: source-locked V176 corpus.py raw byte records, footer exclusion, length cap <=128; check exact raw SHA256 before model training

C.parent: exact same real B3 checkpoint and optimizer/dropout RNG

correction.original_byte: most frequent following ASCII letter only
correction.replacement: different ASCII letter from top16 training letters by frozen SHA256 key
correction.raw_byte_selection: against original unmodified source; no cascade; preserve record lengths and genuine EOS
correction.train_record_selector: first64 edited A-train record IDs by SHA256
correction.invalid_fixture: record incomplete correction outcome, do not replace corpus/edit parameters or retune

corpus.world_status: new prospectively named corpora, not a claim of secret uncontaminated statistical sample
corpus.guard_rule: all code/hyperparams/evaluation fixes frozen in D1 source lock; no guard score used for selection; guard runs regardless development efficacy if source valid

evaluation.all_actual_targets: full257 own teacher-forced next-byte/EOS log loss, accuracy and EOS NLL/false-terminal/Brier
evaluation.train_vs_held: same fixed checkpoint, same target subset, dropout off; report B1,B2,B3
evaluation.A_OLD: unchanged A held original prefixes and labels
evaluation.A_prime_same_KC: corrected A' held positions, unchanged target and full FE-PERM sparse KC code equal original
evaluation.A_prime_changed_KC: corrected A' held positions, unchanged target and sparse KC different from original
evaluation.A_prime_changed_label: corrected A' held position where expected byte changed; score corrected new byte, old/new log odds and full-class top1
evaluation.B_before_after_C: B held loss at actual B3 vs at EDIT C2
evaluation.generation: own 128-step max continuation from 3 observed bytes; emitted genuine EOS, truncation, length histogram, payload/EOS calibration; arbitrary prose exact matching NOT an efficacy gate
evaluation.C_controls: EDIT vs NOEDIT same learning arm, exact common B3 origin, equal record/site exposure
evaluation.external_count_reference: unigram, PPM and interpolated Kneser-Ney fit on actually seen source data; evaluator only; counts/CPU separately
primary_scientific_domains: corrected A' same-KC stable held after edited C2
corrected A' changed-target held after edited C2
evaluation.composite: one quarter each of primary four domains; display all components and per-world signed differences
evaluation.evidence_boundary: promising guarded *development* on predictive statistics if passed; no E2 semantic memory, E3 arithmetic, independent population claim, or core adoption
evaluation.source_guard_independence_caveat: check historical exposure registry; any prior mechanism tuning on guard corpus invalidates 'fresh guard' descriptor without silently substituting texts
